column1: # The first-party payload repos that the payload hooks keep installed and
# current: scripts/payload-update.sh on Unix, scripts/payload-update.ps1 on
# native Windows (docs/payloads.md). This file is the one place that names
# their URLs, install paths and commands, and the coding-agent-kit channel
# this configuration is written for; each command is the repo's own
# documented install or update interface.
# Tab-separated; columns: item field value. Fields:
#   channel          the coding-agent-kit MAJOR.MINOR release channel
#   days             refresh interval: an installed item is updated in the
#                    background once its last success is this many days old
#   unix-probe       succeeds once the item is installed; until then the hook
#   windows-probe    runs its install command in the foreground
#   unix-install     the first-install command
#   windows-install
#   unix-update      the update command (default: the install command, which
#   windows-update   is also the update for PyMOLScripts and awesome-skills);
#                    the kit's names the channel, so a reviewed change of the
#                    channel row moves every installed host to that channel
# The probes test the paths each installer documents as an install: the kit's
# managed root (a current/install.sh on Unix; on Windows install.ps1, the
# entry point of later runs, and the current file), PyMOL's two rc files, and
# awesome-skills' ownership manifests (claude.json, codex.json in its state
# directory, as its older tarball installer left them too) or library clone.
# Unix values are POSIX sh and Windows values PowerShell 7, evaluated by the
# hook with the channel in $channel (sh) or $Channel (PowerShell) and with
#   payload_script INTERPRETER SOURCE [ARG...]       (sh)
#   Invoke-DotfilesPayloadScript SOURCE [ARG...]     (PowerShell)
# which download SOURCE when it is a URL (curl or wget; Invoke-WebRequest)
# into a temporary file, never piping it into a shell, run it with ARG and
# return its exit status (75: another run holds that repo's lock).
